description: Launch a local Chromium routed through a residential proxy exit in a chosen country (and city/state on the Elite tier). Returns a session_id the other aethyn_* tools use. Each session is one sticky identity — a pinned exit IP for the whole task.

city.description: City for Elite-tier targeting, e.g. 'tokyo'. Requires tier:'elite'.

session.description: Your task id. Reuse the same value to pin the same exit IP. Letters/digits/underscore only. Omit to auto-generate.

state.description: State/region for Elite-tier targeting. Requires tier:'elite'.

tier.description: Proxy tier. Elite unlocks city/state targeting. Default 'premium'.

name: aethyn_launch_browser
title: Launch proxied browser
